author: ev-data
purpose: Charging-probability evidence model for a Taipei-style off-street public parking backend; no universal default is adopted.
target_context: Off-street public parking facility in Taipei-like setting (5-minute net occupancy + per-connector status observable); q_need is not identified for this target in this phase.

definitions.q_use: Observed charging EV parking events / all EV parking events, conditional on source context, availability and thresholds.
definitions.q_need: Probability that an EV visit wants to charge before capacity/access restrictions; target input, not identified by observed use alone.
definitions.q_day: Days or vehicle-days with charging / eligible driving days; not a per-parking-event probability.
definitions.q_location_share: Charging at a location or charger type / all charging events or energy; denominator excludes non-charging parking events.
definitions.device_time_utilization: Charging device-minutes / observable device-minutes; a supply-side utilisation, not an arrival probability.
definitions.p_EV_arrival: Share of arriving vehicles at a given facility/time window that are electric; a fleet/trip-composition quantity, not stock share.

q_need_scenarios.basis: Lower bound q_need >= observed q_use holds only if the observed population/event definition matches the target and every observed non-charging visit is a non-wanting visit (an unavailable/queued wanting visit breaks the bound). No non-trivial upper bound is available; stock share, supply share and device utilisation cannot bound arrival composition.

identification.target_estimand: P(want to charge | EV visit to a Taipei-style off-street public parking facility), with visits not conditioned on charger availability.
why_not_identified: No collected dataset has both the full EV parking-event denominator and the charging decision/want at event level for the target.
Observed q_use is conditioned on availability, access rules and price; supply restrictions make q_use a lower bound at best.
The official Taiwan survey (M14) gives self-reported charging frequency, public-charging share and duration but no parking-event denominator.
Taipei 372-site data observe net occupancy and connector status, not per-vehicle visits or charging intent.
M11/M12 full texts are inaccessible this round, so their conditional model definitions/covariates cannot be imported.
M13 public data could not be downloaded (SSL failure) and its correction was not inspected.

what_can_be_estimated: Charging arrival intensity lambda_charge via connector-status transitions (device-minutes in 充電中).
Station-level net occupancy and charging occupancy time series.
Device-time utilisation bounds and dwell/occupancy aggregates (no per-vehicle identity).
Supply indicators: station sizes, connector counts, per-city car-to-gun ratios.
what_cannot_be_estimated: p_EV_arrival (share of arriving vehicles that are EV)
per-vehicle arrival counts and dwell distributions from net occupancy
post-charge dwell labels (still parked after charging) and ICE occupation of charging bays
rated power, energy delivered per session and fault states from the current station data
required_observations_to_identify: Gate/ANPR or ticket-level vehicle type + arrival/departure timestamps per facility (to get p_EV and per-visit events)
Charging request/intent indicator at arrival (e.g., app check-in, plug attempt, queue log) or a linked survey for the same facility
Connector-level session log with start/end, energy and faults
Rated power / allocated power per connector and tariff
A repeated facility-level survey of EV drivers with non-charging visits included

available_conditional_evidence: M09: home-overnight probability depends on SOC and battery size (abstract: ~64% small / ~34% large battery at 60% SOC) — home denominator, not public parking events.
M11: model structure is a mixed-effects logistic with SOC, before/after trips, last-stop indicator; label requires SOC increase >= 10 pp; coefficients not accessible this round.
M12: BEV/PHEV and home/public/other location differences in vehicle-log charging decisions; potential-charging-trip filter unverified.
M14: Taiwan survey gives mean SOC before public charging 29%, public charging duration ~72 min, home-charger availability groups, queue tolerance mostly <=10 min.
M13 (open text): SOC before/after charging distributions by power level and vehicle type; daily charging-event medians 0.81/1.14/1.67.
why_not_logistic_fit: No accessible coefficients, variable coding or random-effect specification (M11 paywalled; M12 paywalled).
No target-facility joint micro-data linking parking visits, SOC and charging decision; estimating a logistic form on unrelated aggregates would be a shape imitation, not a fitted model.
Covariate distributions of the target (SOC at arrival, dwell, home-charging access for this facility's visitors) are unknown; no calibration sample exists.
Without external validation, discrimination metrics would not establish probability calibration.
fitting_requirements: obtain full text/coefficients or open micro-data
unit-record EV visit sample with charging outcome

p_EV_arrival.definition: Share of vehicles arriving at a given facility/time window that are electric (is_ev = 1); denominator is arriving vehicles, not registered vehicles.
why_stock_share_not_arrival_share: Stock share is fleet composition, not trip/visit composition; facility attraction differs by trip purpose, charging availability, pricing and dwell.
EV owners may avoid facilities without charging (selection) or preferentially visit ones with it; either direction is unmeasured.
Fleet/taxi/rental/bus vehicles are counted in city EV stock but have very different arrival frequencies and charging patterns.
Repeated visits weight frequent users; stock share is a vehicle-level ratio.
City/state stock denominators and facility arrival denominators differ in geography and period.
Taipei station data cannot classify vehicle type; net occupancy changes cannot recover arrivals.
